name: curved track
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 线路平面中心线呈曲线形态的轨道。
usage_overview: 作为车辆通过与轮轨接触分析的轨道对象，主要通过曲线半径、超高等几何条件表征其线路特征，并考察这些条件对车辆通过及轮轨接触的影响。

complete_examples.text: In VTCM, the railway vehicle and the curved track are coupled by the nonlinear wheel–rail interaction forces, and through TIPM, the ergodic properties of random track irregularities on amplitudes, wavelengths and probabilities can be properly considered in the dynamic calculations.
Relatively speaking, though the curved track may cause the WR-VF to grow dramatically, the influence is localised and instantaneous without losing much of the reliability.
Introduction To coordinate a railway line complex morphology in geometry, examination of the curved track is important.
It is therefore necessary to establish a vehicle–curved track coupled model with detailed consideration of the curved rail characteristics.
The e®ect of which on vehicle induced vibration of curved track are analyzed in this section.
In this paper, a vehicle–curved track coupled dynamic model constructed by FEM and DEM is established.
